---
title: "Publications"
description: "Generated with R from `data/publications.csv`. Add a row (with a `topic`) to update this page."
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
pubs <- read.csv("data/publications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pubs <- pubs[order(-pubs$year, seq_len(nrow(pubs))), ]
topic_order <- c("Tobacco & Smoking Cessation", "Cannabis", "Opioids & Chronic Pain",
                 "Alcohol", "Digital Well-being", "HIV, Global & Child Health")
topic_order <- c(topic_order, setdiff(unique(pubs$topic), topic_order))

fmt_pub <- function(p) {
  authors <- gsub("Devkota J", "**Devkota J**", p$authors, fixed = TRUE)
  if (isTRUE(p$equal_first) || identical(p$equal_first, "True"))
    authors <- sub("**Devkota J**", "**Devkota J**<sup>\\*</sup>", authors, fixed = TRUE)
  links <- c(
    if (nzchar(p$doi))   sprintf("[DOI](https://doi.org/%s){.badge-link .badge .text-bg-primary}", p$doi),
    if (!is.na(p$pmid) && nzchar(p$pmid)) sprintf("[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%s/){.badge-link .badge .text-bg-secondary}", p$pmid),
    if (nzchar(p$pmcid)) sprintf("[Full text](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/%s/){.badge-link .badge .text-bg-success}", p$pmcid)
  )
  sprintf("- [%s.]{.pub-title}<br>%s.<br>[*%s*, %d]{.pub-meta}<br>%s",
          p$title, authors, p$journal, p$year, paste(links, collapse = " "))
}
print_group <- function(heading, sub, level = "###") {
  cat("\n", level, " ", heading, " [", nrow(sub), "]{.badge .rounded-pill .text-bg-light}\n\n::: {.pub-list}\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub))) cat(fmt_pub(sub[i, ]), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(":::\n")
}
```

For the most current list, see my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=6iIeMA0AAAAJ). <sup>\*</sup> marks equal first authorship.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pubs-year
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-cap: "Publications per year"
ggplot(pubs, aes(factor(year))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#1f4e79", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## By research area

```{r}
#| label: pub-by-topic
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for (tp in topic_order) print_group(tp, pubs[pubs$topic == tp, ])
```

## By year

```{r}
#| label: pub-by-year
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for (yr in unique(pubs$year)) print_group(yr, pubs[pubs$year == yr, ])
```
